cases.description: F-WIDGETS on the GPU: one reviewed 320x180 golden per widget kind (ap02_valuetext fresh/stale/missing, ap02_gauge bar 0/50/100 % + bottom-to-top + arc 0/50/100 % with the bottom gap, ap02_indicator on/off with half-and-half textures + solid tints, ap02_plot two channels over 10 s with a NaN gap + grid + labels, ap02_slider H/V at 0/0.5/1, ap02_toggle on/off tints + textures + image-less fallback, ap02_hostedpanel frame + placeholder), each compared with the harness tolerance PLUS exact sentinel pixels/ROIs (fill edge, knob centre, plot line pixel, texture halves, frame edge); the hosted-panel case also runs CollectHostedPanels (V05 engine half) and the live/DrawnThisFrame placeholder rule. The wrapper hashes tests/render/goldens before and after: every pre-existing golden byte-identical.

Preview vs live A/B on the combined F-WIDGETS scene: Render(bus = nullptr) against Render(bus) with the bus holding exactly the preview values (value, gauge, indicator, toggle, slider and a sample-exact replica of the plot's preview sine) is byte-identical (BytesEqual, in-process pair), and equal to Render(bus, preview = true); with different bus values the diff mask is confined to the bound widgets' rects, every bound widget shows a diff, the hosted panel none.
